name: soul_bolt_launch
for: wraith_lord soul bolt: release at the throwing hand
notes: The soul flame in the Wraith Lord's hand swells and leans forward (frames 1-3), then tears loose on frame 4: a cold white flash, a crescent of cold air snapping open toward +x, torn ectoplasm streaks flung forward and motes rising. Anchor = the hand. 8 frames @12 fps; launch soul_bolt_flight on frame 4. Short enough to replay for each bolt of a volley.
